SELECT json_build_object(
  'database', current_database(),
  'readOnly', current_setting('default_transaction_read_only'),
  'documents', (SELECT json_agg(d) FROM "LegalSourceDocument" d WHERE "legalSourceVersionId"='04c26c33-a408-45a4-aa09-0ce1728ca98c'),
  'chunks', (SELECT json_agg(c) FROM "LegalDocumentChunk" c WHERE "legalSourceVersionId"='04c26c33-a408-45a4-aa09-0ce1728ca98c'),
  'materialization', (SELECT row_to_json(m) FROM "LegalDocumentMaterialization" m WHERE id='2924ffb8a2bb46adc64f5765b1a5f8d3d6d56be73445e988f11705c2e1656e79'),
  'nodes', (SELECT json_agg(n) FROM "LegalDocumentNode" n WHERE "materializationId"='2924ffb8a2bb46adc64f5765b1a5f8d3d6d56be73445e988f11705c2e1656e79'),
  'mappings', (SELECT json_agg(cm) FROM "LegalDocumentChunkNode" cm WHERE "materializationId"='2924ffb8a2bb46adc64f5765b1a5f8d3d6d56be73445e988f11705c2e1656e79')
);
